items.summary: Recommendation: retain the implementation and financial-claim gate. Do not approve revenue, contribution-margin, ROI, causal-lift, forecast, or budget-exposure claims this cycle. Amazon reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, but all commission is on aggregate tracking_id other and cannot be assigned to a site. AI spend is $34.69846565 across 223 calls on 2026-10-01, with only 20 observed sites versus 38 expected. Contribution margin and cost-to-learn are not calculable because revenue and AI costs are not period-aligned, infrastructure/domain costs are absent, site attribution is incomplete, and the 30-day outcome set cannot be causally matched to one-day spend. Minimum measurement: period-aligned site/content revenue by registered tracking ID, AI cost allocation by site/work item, infrastructure and domain invoices, and dated exposure-to-outcome links. The only supported unit metric is AI cost per call: $0.1556, which is not cost-to-learn. Retain principal-engineer capacity reconciliation through 2026-10-02T12:00Z; release at most one candidate only after baseline, threshold, tests, rollback, attribution, and release evidence pass.
